With regard to individual patches, they are usually of oval or elongated form, arranged symmetrically in oblique lines on the back in the direction of the ribs, probably in the lines of fission, more or less horizontal in direction in front, and often, but not always, in vertical lines on the limbs. arxiv-1601-04401.title: The correlation between quarter-point angle and nuclear radius
arxiv-1601-04401.creator: W. H. Ma, J. S. Wang, S. Mukherjee, Q. Wang, D. Patel, Y. Y. Yang, J. B. Ma, P. Ma, S. L. Jin, Z. Bai, X. Q. Liu
arxiv-1601-04401.description: Abstract The correlation between quarter-point angle of elastic scattering and nuclear matter radius has been studied systematically. Various phenomenological formulae with parameters for nuclear radius are adopted and compared by fitting the experimental data of quarter point angle extracted from nuclear elastic scattering reaction systems.

arxiv-2102-04790.title: Performance of the CMS muon trigger system in proton-proton collisions at s = 13 ​ \TeV \sqrt{s}=13\TeV
arxiv-2102-04790.description: Abstract The muon trigger system of the CMS experiment uses a combination of hardware and software to identify events containing a muon. During Run 2 (covering 2015–2018) the LHC achieved instantaneous luminosities as high as 2 × 10 34 ​ \percms 2\times 10^{34}\percms while delivering proton-proton collisions at s = 13 ​ \TeV \sqrt{s}=13\TeV .

arxiv-2208-03479.title: Analysing the Memorability of a Procedural Crime-Drama TV Series, CSI Conference: International Conference on Content-based Multimedia Indexing; September 14–16, 2022; Graz, Austria International Conference on Content-based Multimedia Indexing (CBMI 2022), September 14–16, 2022, Graz, Austria DOI: 1
arxiv-2208-03479.creator: Seán Cummins, Lorin Sweeney and Alan F. Smeaton
arxiv-2208-03479.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Seán Cummins, Lorin Sweeney and Alan F. Smeaton. We investigate the memorability of a 5-season span of a popular crime-drama TV series, CSI, through the application of a vision transformer fine-tuned on the task of predicting video memorability. By investigating the popular genre of crime-drama TV through the use of a detailed annotated corpus combined with video memorability scores, we show how to extrapolate meaning from the memorability scores generated on video shots.

arxiv-2303-00186.title: Targeted demand response for flexible energy communities using clustering techniques
arxiv-2303-00186.creator: Sotiris Pelekis, Angelos Pipergias, Evangelos Karakolis, Spiros Mouzakitis, Francesca Santori, Mohammad Ghoreishi, Dimitris Askounis
arxiv-2303-00186.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Sotiris Pelekis, Angelos Pipergias, Evangelos Karakolis, Spiros Mouzakitis, Francesca Santori, Mohammad Ghoreishi, Dimitris Askounis. The present study proposes clustering techniques for designing demand response (DR) programs for commercial and residential prosumers. The goal is to alter the consumption behavior of the prosumers within a distributed energy community in Italy.

arxiv-2305-14035.title: Can Self-Supervised Neural Representations Pre-Trained on Human Speech distinguish Animal Callers?
arxiv-2305-14035.creator: Eklavya Sarkar 1,2 and Mathew Magimai.-Doss 1
arxiv-2305-14035.description: Abstract Self-supervised learning (SSL) models use only the intrinsic structure of a given signal, independent of its acoustic domain, to extract essential information from the input to an embedding space. This implies that the utility of such representations is not limited to modeling human speech alone.

arxiv-2405-14173.title: Human-Agent Cooperation in Games under Incomplete Information through Natural Language Communication The source code and the full paper with appendix can be found at https://github.com/vivianchen98/shared_control_language .
arxiv-2405-14173.creator: Shenghui Chen, Daniel Fried, Ufuk Topcu
arxiv-2405-14173.description: Abstract Developing autonomous agents that can strategize and cooperate with humans under information asymmetry is challenging without effective communication in natural language. We introduce a shared-control game , where two players collectively control a token in alternating turns to achieve a common objective under incomplete information.

arxiv-2407-04170.title: Attention Normalization Impacts Cardinality Generalization in Slot Attention Thanks: Work done during PhD studies at MPI-IS. Jan Achterhold is now with Robert Bosch GmbH - Corporate Research, and the Bosch Center for Artificial Intelligence (BCAI), Renningen, Germany.
arxiv-2407-04170.creator: Markus Krimmel markus.krimmel@tuebingen.mpg.de, Jan Achterhold jan.achterhold@tuebingen.mpg.de, Joerg Stueckler joerg.stueckler@uni-a.de
arxiv-2407-04170.description: Abstract Object-centric scene decompositions are important representations for downstream tasks in fields such as computer vision and robotics. The recently proposed Slot Attention module, already leveraged by several derivative works for image segmentation and object tracking in videos, is a deep learning component which performs unsupervised object-centric scene decomposition on input images.

arxiv-2412-11325.title: Sonicmesh: Enhancing 3D Human Mesh Reconstruction in Vision-Impaired Environments With Acoustic Signals
arxiv-2412-11325.creator: Xiaoxuan Liang, Hong Zhou, Zhaolong Wei, Yansong Li, Shujian Yu, Jeremy Gummeson
arxiv-2412-11325.description: Abstract 3D human mesh reconstruction (HMR) from RGB images often degrades under poor illumination, occlusion, and non-line-of-sight conditions. Acoustic sensing provides complementary spatial cues but suffers from low spatial resolution. We propose SonicMesh , which, to the best of our knowledge, is the first acoustic–visual framework for robust 3D human mesh reconstruction.

arxiv-2501-18752.title: A Novel Method to Estimate the FUV Flux and a Catalogue for Star-Hosting Discs in Nearby Star-Forming Regions
arxiv-2501-18752.creator: Rossella Anania, Andrew J. Winter, Giovanni Rosotti, Miguel Vioque, Eleonora Zari, Michelangelo Pantaleoni González, Leonardo Testi
arxiv-2501-18752.description: Abstract Protoplanetary discs, when externally irradiated by Far Ultraviolet (FUV) photons from OBA-type stars, lose material through photoevaporative winds, reducing the amount of material available to form planets. Understanding the link between environmental irradiation and observed disc properties requires accurately evaluating the FUV flux at star-hosting discs, which can be challenging due stellar parallax uncertainties.

arxiv-2503-17225.title: China and G7 in the Current Context of the World Trading
arxiv-2503-17225.creator: N.S. Gonchar, O.P. Dovzhyk, A.S. Zhokhin, W.H. Kozyrski, A.P. Makhort
arxiv-2503-17225.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by N.S. Gonchar, O.P. Dovzhyk, A.S. Zhokhin, W.H. Kozyrski, A.P. Makhort. The paper analyses trade between the most developed economies of the world. The analysis is based on the previously proposed model of international trade. This model of international trade is based on the theory of general economic equilibrium. The demand for goods in this model is built on the import of goods by each of the countries participating in the trade.

arxiv-2505-02287.title: Continuous Normalizing Flows for Uncertainty-Aware Human Pose Estimation
arxiv-2505-02287.creator: Shipeng Liu, Ziliang Xiong, Bastian Wandt, Per-Erik Forssén
arxiv-2505-02287.description: Abstract Human Pose Estimation (HPE) is increasingly important for applications like virtual reality and motion analysis, yet current methods struggle with balancing accuracy, computational efficiency, and reliable uncertainty quantification (UQ). Traditional regression-based methods assume fixed distributions, which might lead to poor UQ. Heatmap-based methods effectively model the output distribution using likelihood heatmaps, however, they demand significant resources.

arxiv-2506-00174.title: Constrained Bayesian Optimization under Bivariate Gaussian Process with Application to Cure Process Optimization
arxiv-2506-00174.creator: Yezhuo Li, Qiong Zhang
arxiv-2506-00174.description: Abstract Bayesian Optimization, leveraging Gaussian process models, has proven to be a powerful tool for minimizing expensive-to-evaluate objective functions by efficiently exploring the search space. Extensions such as constrained Bayesian Optimization have further enhanced Bayesian Optimization’s utility in practical scenarios by focusing the search within feasible regions defined by a black-box constraint function.

arxiv-2506-13123.title: SAGDA: Open-Source Synthetic Agriculture Data for Africa
arxiv-2506-13123.creator: Abdelghani Belgaid, Oumnia Ennaji
arxiv-2506-13123.description: Abstract Data scarcity in African agriculture hampers machine learning (ML) model performance, limiting innovations in precision agriculture. The Synthetic Agriculture Data for Africa (SAGDA) library, a Python-based open-source toolkit, addresses this gap by generating, augmenting, and validating synthetic agricultural datasets.

pmc-12698198.creator: Kristen Jacklin, Melissa Blind, Karen Pitawanakwat, Antonio Paniagua Guzman, Dana Ketcher, Leland Bell, Indira Galeeva, Wayne Warry, Ulla Kriebernegg
pmc-12698198.description: Dementia is a prevalent and growing concern among Indigenous communities. pmc-13382025.creator: Bingqing Wang, Zuxin Xu, Bin Dong
pmc-13382025.description: Understanding the fate and transformation of antibiotics is essential for controlling antibiotic pollution in wastewater treatment plants (WWTPs).
